description.value:
A tribe of insect-like beastmen known to inhabit the south region of the Dravanian Forelands, spiritually linked to their leader as the Onemind.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Gnaths gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom and -4 Strength.
  • Size: Gnaths are Small creatures.
  • Type: Gnaths are humanoids with the gnath subtype.
  • Base Speed: Gnaths have a base speed of 20 feet and a 20-ft burrowing speed.
  • Languages: Common and Undercommon. Gnaths with high Intelligence scores can choose from Antican, Goblin, Kobold, and Yagudo.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Exoskeleton: Gnaths have an exoskeleton granting +1 natural armor bonus.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Crafty: Gnaths gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) and Profession (miner) checks. Craft (alchemy) is always a class skill.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Limited Telepathy: Gnaths mentally communicate with any creature within 30 feet sharing a language.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Weapon Familiarity: Gnaths are proficient with the scimitar, katana, light and heavy crossbows, and short bows.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Carrion Sense: Gnaths sniff out carrion, functioning like scent but only for corpses/badly wounded creatures.
  • Darkvision: Gnaths can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Light Sensitivity: Gnaths mostly live in dark tunnels and suffer from light sensitivity.
